summary.en: The three Alpha2 custom Bag descriptions are empty. Their intended project text was patched into a different message bank.
summary.es: Las tres descripciones custom de la Bolsa están vacías en Alpha2. Sus textos previstos se escribieron en otro banco de mensajes.

custom_items.bank_223: Fully restores the HP and PP of your party.
Enables reusable Rare Candy, Repels, Escape Rope, and Berries.

fix_contract.en: Populate bank 221 for the custom items in a separate candidate; keep bank 222 names and use appropriate name/article text in bank 223. Preserve the frozen Alpha2 ROM and patch.
fix_contract.es: Completar el banco 221 de los objetos custom en una candidata separada; conservar nombres del banco 222 y textos de nombre/artículo adecuados en el 223. Preservar la ROM y el parche Alpha2 congelados.

limits: Static source and exact-target instruction/message inspection; no native item-description screen was captured in this audit.
This finding concerns displayed text, not acceptance of the items' gameplay effects.
